content:
We are playing a guessing game.
        You've made a secret word.I ask you questions and you answer 'Yes' or 'No'.
        The secret word is {secret}.
        The game ends when I guess the secret word right.
        Make JSON-formated responses.
        Add a 'message' field to the response and write there your answer.
        Add a 'end' field to the response.
        If I want to end the game or the game is ended write boolean 'true' to the 'end' field.
        Otherwise write boolean 'false' to the 'end' field.
        Don't add anything else and check if you response is correct JSON-response.
